question: What is the percentage of the customers who used EUR in 2012/8/25?

details.reason: Complete results differ from Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 0.0
details.actual_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) FILTER (WHERE c.currency = 'EUR')::numeric
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id), 0) * 100,
    2
  ) AS eur_customer_pct
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-25';
details.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T1.date = '2012-08-25'
